canonical_name: No Supply Chain Controls and Processes
description: Supply chain controls and processes are not established to ensure adequate security and integrity of products and services throughout the supply chain, including verification of security functions and critical components.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Federal information systems processing sensitive data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of supply chain security processes, lack of supplier security assessments, missing verification procedures for products and services, absence of supply chain threat monitoring, and lack of documented controls to address supply chain weaknesses. Check for missing processes to identify and mitigate supply chain vulnerabilities, counterfeit components, and malicious insertions during development, manufacturing, or delivery.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Supply Chain Risk Management
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
